purpose: Canonical corrected status for Martingale rounds 1-14. Extends r13 corrected status with Round 14 results.

r14_htf_on_icp_trx.label: htf_on_icp_trx
r14_htf_on_icp_trx.notes: HTF gate reduces ann from 35.67→33.00 but increases DD from 14.44→26.62. 5/5 positive segments is an improvement over r13's 4/5. Default HTF config too aggressive.

r14_htf_off_icp_trx.label: htf_off_icp_trx
r14_htf_off_icp_trx.notes: Baseline without HTF gate. Matches r13 corrected ann=36.4%. 5/5 positive segments improvement. DD=14.44% close to conservative 10% gate.

r14_htf_on_r4_combo.label: htf_on_r4_combo
r14_htf_on_r4_combo.notes: 6-symbol R4-combo with HTF gate. Seg 3 (2025) negative -10.83%. Budget ladder: 1000→72%, 2000→47%, 3000→35%, 4000→28%, 4999→24%.
